zh.set: 前左柱头的斗拱：三个榫卯把它扣在一起
zh.tenon: 馒头榫：柱头的方榫插进栌斗底的卯口，栌斗不会滑走
zh.crosslap: 十字刻半：华栱和泥道栱各刻去一半，十字扣在一起
zh.dovetail: 燕尾榫：阑额的燕尾头从上面落进柱头的槽，拉不出来

en.set: The bracket set on the front-left column: three joints hold it together
en.tenon: Tenon: the column's square tenon goes into the socket under the big block, so the block cannot slide
en.crosslap: Cross-lap: each arm loses half its depth where they cross, so they lock at one level
en.dovetail: Dovetail: the tie beam's flared end drops into the column's slot from above and cannot be pulled out
